clues.text: After the land was subdued, the whole congregation of Israel gathered here and set up the Tent of Meeting.
Joshua cast lots here in the presence of the LORD, dividing the land among the tribes of Israel.
After eating and drinking here, Hannah stood up to pray while Eli the priest sat by the temple doorpost.
After losing a battle to the Philistines, Israel sent men here to bring back the ark of the covenant.
At a yearly feast here, Benjamites hid in the vineyards to catch wives from the young women dancing.
Jeroboam's wife came here to the house of the old prophet Ahijah, who could no longer see.
Through Jeremiah, God told Judah to go see what He did where He first made a dwelling for His Name.
